entries.english: Relations with Hohenlohe-Weikersheim. Date range: 1556–1569, 1586, 1660–1671, 1709–1741. Contains: 1. treaties and draft treaties between Rosenberg or Hatzfeldt, on the one hand, and Hohenlohe-Weikersheim, on the other, to settle neighborly disputes (with rotulus), 1558–1569, 1568, 1660–1671, 1709–1723; 2. letters from the bailiff and rent collector at Creglingen to Zaisolph von Rosenberg concerning cows seized by Hohenlohe at Ebertsbronn, 1564; 3. arrangements of conference dates to settle neighborly disputes, 1709–1741; 4. correspondence between the Haltenbergstetten and Weikersheim chanceries concerning joint conferences, 174–1716. Extent: 1 file.
